text:
omar_partnerships: Quick sync request 1: Astra appliance + marketplace integration bundle offers. Need alignment on tiering, appliance crediting, SI enablement funds, and phased announcement plan. Thoughts?

ravi_sales: Good timing. Customer asks for 24mo commitment with hardware uplift. Suggest two tiers: 300k ARR and 2M ARR. Discounts: 10% and 25%. For 2M tier include a one-time appliance credit equal to 8% of contract value (applies after first invoice).

leah_pm: We should separate token/embedding SKU from appliance hours. Draft SKU mapping for the bundle:
```
sku_commit_small: astra-bundle-300k
sku_commit_large: astra-bundle-2m
sku_appliance_credit: astra-appliance-credit-hrs
sku_reserved_hours: astra-reserved-256
```
Also recommend an activation milestone: SI-led onboarding within 45 days for smaller deals, 30 days for larger.

kevin_finance: Protecting margin is critical. Minimum gross margin target = 58%. Appliance credit capped at $150k. For 24mo prepay we can front-load a bigger discount; otherwise require 3mo deposit. Renewal mechanics: auto-offer to renew 120 days before term end with a 60-day opt-out window. Add year-end usage reconciliation.

tasha_ops: Announcement cadence: propose three phases: 1) internal partner launch (partners-only listing) 2) marketplace private offer live + partner customer email (T+3 days) 3) public blog + PR (T+21 days after private live). Ops tasks: marketplace metadata, playbook for support tiers, enablement sessions for SI. I can own the checklist.

ravi_sales: On unused commit policy 1: prefer pro-rated appliance credits (roll-to-appliance) instead of expiry. That reduces churn. Need finance/legal to decide minimum conversion ratios.

kevin_finance: Pro-rate to appliance is acceptable if we model worst-case. Require a conversion cap: no more than 40% of commit can become appliance credit, remainder is non-refundable or expires. Also suggest a 20% non-refundable deposit on sign for both tiers.

leah_pm: Fallback routing: if appliance deployment windows slip, allow customers temporary hosted usage at the committed price-tier for up to 60 days, with clear SLAs and a discount reconciliation if hosted costs exceed expected appliance costs. Flag infra team to validate capacity for that scenario.

partners-bot: private-offer-draft generated: /marketplace/drafts/astra-appliance-bundle-2026 (creator: omar_partnerships)

omar_partnerships: Thanks 1. Can someone drop a compact term sheet and a sample marketplace listing copy? Also need a tentative press owner.

ravi_sales: I'll draft term sheet and take press owner with marketing co-pilot. Dropping doc: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/astra-appliance-term-sheet (WIP)

kevin_finance: I'll run margin sims on the 10% vs 25% discounts and the appliance cap by EOB.

leah_pm: Scheduling 30min sync tomorrow 9am PT to lock commit bands and conversion caps. Please RSVP.

omar_partnerships: Great. Agenda for sync: final bands, appliance-credit rules, SI enablement funding, announcement timeline. :thumbsup:
